newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso deals delayed due to power failure.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso deals delayed due to power failure.

text.p: Philippine peso-U.S. dollar deals among banks were delayed on Monday due to a power failure which affected the electronic trading system, a Central Bank official said.
Trading normally starts at 8:30 a.m. (0030 GMT).
"There are deals being done but it is not captured by the machine," a foreign bank dealer said.
The done deals will be included as soon as the system is up, the dealer said.
"So far, I know there were done deals at 26.365," he added.
The peso closed at 26.369 on Friday.
